A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Poly2Graph and HSG-12M work. Their text, equations, figures, tables and appendices A–H support reliable comparison; relocated material can be matched across versions.

before.justification: v2 reports original GNN classification experiments in Table 2 and Tables A5–A8, plus measured Poly2Graph runtime comparisons in Table A3.

after.justification: v4 retains the original classification experiments and runtime measurements in Table 2 and Tables A3 and A5–A8.

M1.justification: Section 2, Algorithm 1 and Appendix C retain the same companion-matrix root finding, spectral-potential/DOS calculation, adaptive refinement, skeletonization and graph post-processing. The reference graph featurization is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same five static HSG variants: one-band, two-band, three-band, topology and HSG-12M. Polynomial coverage and tutorial scenarios are retained, while temporal prediction remains future work. The new physics citations introduce no evaluated datasets or scenarios.

E2.justification: The classification comparisons retain GCN, GAT, GATv2, GIN, GINE, MF, CGCNN and GraphSAGE. Table A3 retains Tai and Lee (2023) as the runtime comparator. Changed citation numbers do not alter comparator membership.

E3.justification: Appendix E retains stratified 8:1:1 splits, batch size 6000, caps of 100 epochs and 1000 steps, parameter matching within 4%, and the same model configurations and metrics. The runtime comparison protocol is also unchanged.

E4.justification: The fragmentation examples in Figure A4, thresholding observations in C.3, and supplementary model analyses in E.4 are retained. No ablation, sensitivity study, robustness test or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both report GNN results as mean and standard deviation over three seeds, identified in E.2 as 42, 2025 and 666. The uncertainty reporting in Tables 2, A3 and A5–A8 is unchanged.

E6.justification: Corresponding results in Tables 2, A3 and A5–A8 are unchanged. For example, GraphSAGE's HSG-12M accuracy remains 0.546 ± 0.004 and Top-10 accuracy remains 0.952 ± 0.001. The spectral examples and qualitative findings also match.

T1.justification: The definitions and non-Bloch mathematical development in Appendix B, algorithmic equations in C, and Toeplitz-decomposition argument in F are unchanged. New Appendix A.4 surveys prior research without introducing formal definitions, assumptions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the claims of automated spectral-graph extraction, a first large-scale spatial multigraph dataset, new GNN challenges and algebra-to-graph universality. The added literature review does not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning edge geometry, GraphSAGE under constrained budgets and inverse-design retrieval remain unchanged. Appendices C.6 and H retain the fragmentation, representation and temporal-evaluation limitations. E.5's added AI4Science wording supplies no substantive new interpretation.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, data formats, licensing and code/data access information are retained. Appendix G contains the same installation instructions, API examples and outputs; bibliographic URL additions do not change access to the work's resources.

R1.justification: Beyond the retained mathematical background, v4 adds Appendix A.4, substantially expanding the graph-learning-focused related-work appendix into non-Hermitian classification, bulk-boundary correspondence, generalized Brillouin zones, spectral morphology, responses and experimental realizations. Numerous new physics references support this survey, and E.5 adds AI4Science citations.

P1.justification: Limited edits clarify 'C-plane', correct Figure 1 caption grammar, add A.4 to the appendix structure and revise E.5's closing paragraph. Most prose and the overall section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Existing appendix figures and tables shift relative to surrounding text. For example, Figure A6 follows the dataset discussion in v4, and Tables A5–A8 are grouped on one page instead of two. Figure content and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: New Appendix A.4 provides more complete physics-literature context for the existing contribution, accompanied by small clarity edits. This improves scholarly context without materially changing the methodology, empirical support or acknowledged limitations, supporting a limited overall quality gain.
